style: Say curiously and warmly, like a friendly school librarian wondering out loud with a class.
lines: Welcome to Vibration Station! Let's make things shake, and listen. Tap a rubber band to pluck it.
See the band shake? The shake makes the sound. Tap Hold still to stop it.
Still band, no sound!
The fat band makes a lower sound. The thin band makes a higher sound.
Tap, and the rice jumps! The drum shakes when it makes a sound. Try the mallet.
A bigger hit makes a bigger shake, and a louder sound.
Put your fingers on your throat and hum. Feel the shake? Our hum makes the wrap shake, and the sprinkles dance.
Bang! Nothing touched the bowl, but the rice jumped. The sound made it shake.
The microphone is on. Everyone hum together, and watch the sprinkles.
The microphone is not working here. Press and hold Hum instead.
Tap Find out to test it like a scientist.
Tap a band to pluck it, and watch.
Pluck a band. Then tap Hold still while it rings.
We can't see a drum shake. What can we put on it? Tap rice, sand or the sticker.
Now tap the drum with the finger or the mallet.
Press and hold Hum, and everyone hum!
Everyone hum together, now!
Look. The pan is touching the bowl. Is that a fair test? Tap Move the pan, or tap Bang.
The band shook, and we heard it. Shaking makes sound!
We held it still, and the sound stopped. No shake, no sound!
The rice jumped! The drum shakes when it makes a sound.
The sand jumped! The drum shakes when it makes a sound.
Our hum made the wrap shake, and the sprinkles danced. Sound makes things shake!
Nothing touched the bowl, and the rice jumped. The pan's sound made it shake!
Just like we thought!
A surprise! Now we know.
Pluck it first. Then tap Hold still while it rings.
The sound already stopped. Pluck again, then tap Hold still fast.
The sticker is stuck on, so we can't see it jump. Tap rice or sand.
The rice jumped. But the pan was touching the bowl, so the bang could shake it right through the pan. We can't tell! Tap Move the pan.
Now nothing touches the bowl. Tap Bang!
Tap Next.
We found out two things. Shaking makes sound. And sound makes things shake!
Tap Reach Sam to use sound to talk far away.
This is Sam, across the yard. Let's build a cup phone to talk to Sam! Tap Paper cup or Tin can.
A paper cup. Its bottom can shake. Tap the pencil.
A tin can. Its bottom can shake. Tap the pencil.
Now tap the string to push it through.
Tap the knot, so the string can't slip out.
Sam tied his end too. Tap Step back until the string is tight.
The string is tight! Tap Talk, and everyone say: Hello, Sam!
That's as far as the string goes.
Tie the knot first. Tap the knot.
Sam can't hear. The string is droopy. Tap Step back.
Sam heard you! Your voice shook the cup, the cup shook the string, and the string shook Sam's cup.
Tap Talk, and everyone say: Meet me at the slide!
Sam can't hear! Look at the string. Then tap the thing that needs fixing.
Yes! The string was droopy. Sam steps back. Now tap Talk.
Yes! Ben was holding the string still. Now it can shake. Tap Talk.
Yes! The string came out of Sam's cup. Sam ties it. Tap Talk.
Talking louder didn't help.
Ben isn't touching the string.
The string is already tight.
That knot is tied.
Watch the shake go down the string. See where it stops? Tap that.
Sam heard you!
You fixed it three times. A cup phone needs a string that is tight and free to shake.
Where can Sam hear us? Tap a place. Then tap whisper, cup phone or drum.
Sam can't hear a whisper from across the yard.
Sam hears the cup phone, and only Sam!
Boom! Sam hears the drum. So does everyone next door.
Too far! Sam can't hear a whisper.
Our string isn't long enough to reach across the park.
Boom! The drum is loud enough to reach Sam across the park.
Our chart is full. Tap Next.
Here is a secret: the treasure is under the slide. Look at our chart. Tap the best way to tell only Sam.
The cup phone! Only Sam heard the secret.
Boom! Oh no, everyone next door heard. Tap another way.
Sam can't hear a whisper that far. Tap another way.
Sam is across the park. Our cup phone can't reach. For Lunch, Play and Home, tap one, two, three or four beats to make a drum code.
Two pictures have the same beats. Sam can't tell them apart. Change one.
Our code is ready.
Sam got all three! We used sound to talk far away.
Keep holding Hum until the sprinkles dance. Then let go.
Tap whisper, cup phone or drum to test this place.
Tap Next to make a drum code.
Tap Bench to explore again, or tap Find out to open the lab book.
Will the band shake when it makes a sound? It will shake, or It will stay still. Say your guess, then tap a picture.
If we hold the band still, will the sound keep going? The sound keeps going, or The sound stops. Tap a picture.
When we tap the drum, does it shake? It shakes, or It stays still. Tap a picture.
Will our hum make the wrap on the tube shake? It will shake, or It will stay still. Tap a picture.
Can the pan's sound make the rice jump, with nothing touching the bowl? The rice will jump, or The rice will stay still. Tap a picture.
We think: It will shake.
We think: It will stay still.
We think: The sound keeps going.
We think: The sound stops.
We think: It shakes.
We think: It stays still.
We think: The rice will jump.
We think: The rice will stay still.
Tell Sam: Lunch is ready. Look at our code, then tap the drum.
Tell Sam: Come play ball. Look at our code, then tap the drum.
Tell Sam: Time to go home. Look at our code, then tap the drum.
